domain: Every process satisfying Definitions 1-2, Assumptions 1-2, the Holder condition for all k, and p>=2.
statement: E R_BG(M_hat) is bounded by m^(-2alpha/d_eff)+m/(pN)polylog(pN)+N^-1 polylog(pN), up to fixed constants.
falsification_acceptance: One fixed process satisfies every assumption.
Every theta and m has a positive exact Bayes-Gap lower bound.
The claimed RHS tends to zero along an explicit integer sequence.
non_circularity: The fixed p=2 law has an m,N-independent exact lower bound; no fitted finite-sample budget is used.
